batch: Phase J -- T8+T11 family-expansion scan (deduped, 227 raw candidates), individually classified. Reused the Phase G TIP-marker method (biographical-marker text = person, People-from/group = collective) uniformly across both buckets rather than trusting which cluster the scan associated a candidate with -- resolved several codes that surfaced in BOTH T8 and T11 raw lists (Judah/Levi Greek variants) correctly per-code via their own TIP text (an apostle named Judas vs the patriarch who founded the tribe of Judah are different Strong's codes with different TIP entries, both happen to gloss similarly in English). 33 candidates had NO TIP/gloss row at all (Matthew 1 genealogy names, mostly) -- resolved via the verse_lexical.surface field (the actual translated word) instead of leaving them unclassified. Two items (village, altar) were redirected to T10/T12 -- real content, wrong type for T8/T11.
